patch.title: In lessons/seven.tex, change the nested list opener from \\begin{enumerate} to \\begin{itemize} so the nested environment closes with \\end{itemize} before the outer \\end{enumerate}. This resolves the compile error while leaving the lemma counter (standalone global counter → still Lemma 1), the answers, and the lemma content unchanged.
